title: [FOR HIRE] Struggling with your brand identity? Let me help you out
description:
Hey I'm Rish graphic designer here, 6+ years in, worked with 50+ brands across logos, identity, apparel, and posters. Sharing recent work + rates in case anyone's looking or knows someone who is.

.

My approach is strategy-first before I open Illustrator, I'm thinking about who the audience actually is and why a choice will land with them, not just chasing something that looks nice on a mood board.

Recent work:

.

[Branding ] → Hexwerks Logo, Brand Visuals, Lighting

.

[T-shirts & Merch ] → Dsplace Official Apparel & Headwear Collection

.

[Posters & Flyers ] → Poster Collection

.

[Full portfolio] → behance.net/graphiccookinglab

.

Rates:

Logo design: $400 flat

Everything else (identity, apparel, posters): $40/hr

.

How I work: clear timeline upfront, regular updates as work progresses, no vanishing for two weeks mid-project. Payments via PayPal, Wise, or bank transfer.

.

Open to one-off projects or ongoing work. Drop a comment or DM if something here catches your eye, or if you've got a project brewing happy to talk through it.
